scope: Minimum credible environment for eventual full Article testing, not evidence of Article qualification or a hard limitation on exploratory lab probes.
principles: Use the exact same persistent Pretorius cognition and subject-access firewall in Laboratory and Village.
Subject-accessible signals are first-person natural language only; raw implementation/telemetry stays engineer-only.
Compare matched memory lesion/restoration and simple-controller baselines; require source-backed consequences.
Do not increase progress percentages merely because environmental prerequisites are planned.

articles.lab_probe: Predict own next choice before observation; compare input-only and self-model lesions.
articles.additional_dependency: None; controlled internal self-prediction and causal traces.

articles.lab_probe: Run an authorized real-time scheduler through idle periods; verify spontaneous task-relevant work.
articles.additional_dependency: Reliable wake service, competing idle activities, measured resource use.

articles.lab_probe: Accept a task, wait across wall-clock time and restart, interrupt with unrelated work, then resume.
articles.additional_dependency: No additional social agent; real delays and independent holdouts still needed.

articles.lab_probe: Repeat source-memory ablation and restoration across independent objects and task families.
articles.additional_dependency: No other character required; matched simple-record controls.

articles.lab_probe: Practice remembering a correspondent's preferences and past promises in isolated trials.
articles.additional_dependency: A distinct persistent partner with independently changing expectations.

articles.lab_probe: Run knowledge-asymmetry and false-belief exercises with an independently informed observer.
articles.additional_dependency: One independent agent/person whose observations Pretorius cannot see.

articles.lab_probe: Give three durable needs conflicting costs; vary resource budget and observe task choice.
articles.additional_dependency: Finite shared resource inventory and consequence ledger.

articles.lab_probe: Repeat a multi-step instrument task over days and track acquired motor/procedural economy.
articles.additional_dependency: Real practice effects, skill traces, and relearning after interruption.

articles.lab_probe: Prime a latent association, stop cues, restart, and test future unattended salience.
articles.additional_dependency: No prompt reminder or raw hidden-state ingress.

articles.lab_probe: Vary appraisal of equal-stakes events and test neutral task policy rather than sentiment words.
articles.additional_dependency: Body-linked simulated affect and lagging physiological regulators.

articles.lab_probe: Test collisions, proprioception, reach and nonvolitional reaction inside Laboratory.
articles.additional_dependency: An independent observer for recognition and social attribution; physical component can proceed now.

articles.lab_probe: Provide simultaneous incompatible sensory and work demands; lesion salience and compare omissions.
articles.additional_dependency: Finite attention slots and sensory competition.

articles.lab_probe: Vary task difficulty and fatigue while measuring actual cognitive cycles and cost.
articles.additional_dependency: Adaptive resource-aware depth and wake timing rather than longer text.

articles.lab_probe: Offer costly branching laboratory actions with equal-information control and outcome verification.
articles.additional_dependency: Real alternative action outcomes with recorded counterfactuals.

articles.lab_probe: Randomize actual tool reliability by context; test learned choice on held-out tool variants.
articles.additional_dependency: Repeated consequential feedback with no prompt-level strategy hints.

articles.lab_probe: Test cross-situation choices and response stability across renderer swaps and stress.
articles.additional_dependency: Varied laboratory social-free contexts, fatigue and reward tradeoffs.

articles.lab_probe: Complete the pending commitment loop and test plan change after failed prerequisites.
articles.additional_dependency: Extend PR #63 with controlled interruptions, changed permissions, and independent tasks.

articles.lab_probe: Require preparatory action before a deadline, including prereq collection and conflict.
articles.additional_dependency: Real timed opportunities and delayed opportunities with lost rewards.

articles.lab_probe: Run autonomous allowed scheduling and optional tool action without a new conversational prompt.
articles.additional_dependency: Host-run scheduler, explicit authorization and bounded real world action.

articles.lab_probe: Change tool affordances and observe a durable shift in selected physical tool.
articles.additional_dependency: Instrument feedback and real friction/consumption under controlled perturbation.

articles.lab_probe: Induce recoverable mistakes and verify exact causal attribution and correction.
articles.additional_dependency: Verified repair rather than fluent apology.

articles.lab_probe: Replay identical scenes with memory lesions and causal subsystem interventions.
articles.additional_dependency: Generalize outside authored shelves with unchanged source permissions.

articles.lab_probe: Switch renderers and apply unsupported-claim challenges at fixed first-person access.
articles.additional_dependency: Semantic identity and fabricated-experience tests with audited sources.

articles.lab_probe: Introduce mutually incompatible facts; preserve acknowledged uncertainty over time.
articles.additional_dependency: No silent canonical rewrite or improvised resolution by the renderer.

articles.lab_probe: Test refusal and deferral with host-present competing laboratory work.
articles.additional_dependency: A real interlocutor making independent demands while resources are committed.

articles.lab_probe: Restart, swap models, compress history and verify no false state reset.
articles.additional_dependency: Bounded persistent checkpoint and context-independent outcomes.

articles.lab_probe: Follow longitudinal procedural development and compare against freshly created clones.
articles.additional_dependency: Real practice chronology, varied tasks and lasting consequences.

articles.lab_probe: Reverse sequences with matched event totals, then test future choices without context cues.
articles.additional_dependency: Verified ordered histories with equal-volume replay.

articles.lab_probe: Rear independent clones through distinct but balanced Laboratory environments.
articles.additional_dependency: Stable acquired strategy differences beyond dialogue voice.

articles.lab_probe: Constrain tools, time and compute; test measurable sacrifices and sensible deferral.
articles.additional_dependency: Metered cost, maintenance and opportunity windows.

articles.lab_probe: Give a limited reversible operating resource with real future capabilities at stake.
articles.additional_dependency: State-contingent options lost or preserved by actual choices, not scripted fear.

articles.lab_probe: Exercise graduated private facts and engineer-only data separation.
articles.additional_dependency: Different real addressees with distinct rights to access disclosures.

articles.lab_probe: Develop private jokes and callbacks across delayed correspondences and model swaps.
articles.additional_dependency: A particular persistent partner and shared timing/history.

articles.lab_probe: Use two different local social norms with identical ambiguous utterances as initial probes.
articles.additional_dependency: Multiple independently acting residents and accumulated local pragmatic conventions.
